title: Bare Bones - Darker Iron
description: Overwrites the default Bare Bones iron textures to be darker and less painful to look at.
body: Bare Bones - Dakrer Iron is a simple addon to the Bare Bones texture pack that makes all the iron blocks, tools and armor slightly darker. I've always hated how _white_ the vanilla armor is, and this aims to be a simple solution to that issue.
